title: A preflight to a double-slash path answers 204, but the real request is redirected, which a browser engine refuses
notes: Unverified that any client sends one; a server address with a trailing slash might. Only a browser-engine client sends a preflight, so no device in JS-075 answers this; Chromium on another origin (JS-144's evidence) can. Kept until a browser-engine client reports it; then plan: answer the path without a redirect.
